purpose: Teach: 振り込み/括弧/持ち物/鋭意/即刻/告示/第一線/積算

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究助成の振り込みを確認しろ
lines.en: Ren, make sure you confirm the research grant transfer.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. A task given to someone trusted. No inflection of doubt — this is routine competence he expects. Businesslike but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の括弧書きの注釈を統一しました
lines.en: Yes. I've standardized the annotations in the paper's parenthetical notes.
lines.style: Earnest, eager to report progress. Slight formality — addressing the boss. Quick delivery, trying to prove readiness. A beat of pride underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験室への持ち物制限を守れ
lines.en: Ren, follow the lab's equipment restrictions. No exceptions.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. A rule-reminder dressed as an instruction. Measured pace. Expects compliance without needing to threaten it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文執筆に鋭意取り組んでおります
lines.en: Yes. I'm making steady progress on the paper write-up.
lines.style: Formal, slightly stiff. He's reporting status carefully. Slight hesitation before 'progress' — wanting it to sound genuine, not just polished. Respectful distance in his voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、安全上の問題は即刻指導員に報告しろ
lines.en: Ren, any safety concerns go directly to your advisor immediately. No delay.
lines.style: Heavier weight on this one. Still composed, but the instruction carries real gravity. Slower. A warning that sounds like care. Eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究募集の告示を掲示しました
lines.en: Yes. I posted the research recruitment notice on the board.
lines.style: Quick, factual report. He's moving through the task list. Formal register maintained. A small sense of relief — another item completed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、第一線の研究者の論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren, reference the papers from leading researchers in the field as well.
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Not criticism — guidance. A suggestion from someone who's read the work and sees where it needs depth. Open, collaborative tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の積算を学会論文の付録に載せました
lines.en: Yes. I've included the research budget breakdown in the conference paper appendix.
lines.style: Last in the list. Slight winding-down in pace. Still formal, still eager to demonstrate completion, but fatigue at the edges. Trailing softly — waiting for the next instruction.
